records.name: dropbear_process
records.command: for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do [ -r "$d/comm" ] || continue; [ "$(cat "$d/comm")" = dropbear ] || continue; printf 'pid=%s exe=' "${d##*/}"; readlink "$d/exe"; tr '\000' '\n' < "$d/cmdline" | awk '$0 ~ /^[-a-zA-Z0-9_.\/:]+$/ {print}'; done
